slices.name: Repo guardrails and PR packet
acceptanceCriteria: Build operating model documents one-man-army execution discipline.
Slice manifest defines S0-S9 with allowed files, forbidden files, acceptance criteria, and validation commands.
PR template includes the 10-field review packet.
Only allowed documentation/config files are staged and committed.
slices.notes: This slice creates the control system for all later slices. It must not modify product UI, runtime code, auth, migrations, or Source implementation.

slices.name: Context Bundle contracts
acceptanceCriteria: Typed Context Bundle contract covers tenant, work object, evidence, workflow, patterns, files, conversation, and quality state.
Contract can represent portfolio, program, Source event, stage, artifact, scorecard, and low-context states.
No model calls are introduced.
No UI expansion is introduced.
slices.notes: Use existing Source context contracts as a reference, but avoid overfitting the global runtime to Source only.

slices.name: Context scoring/classifier
acceptanceCriteria: 5-state bundle classifier is deterministic.
6-dimension quality scoring is computed before composition.
Vanilla-response risk can block or downgrade composition.
Tests use fixtures and do not call external models.
slices.notes: This slice should turn context quality into a runtime gate, not just a display score.

slices.name: Source context validation fixtures
acceptanceCriteria: Fixtures cover Source portfolio context, event context, Scope stage context, missing event, and low-context states.
Assertions verify lifecycle, owner, aging, next action, missing inputs, scorecard/artifact/value placeholders, pattern identity, and quality scores.
No Source UI files are modified.
No model calls are made.
slices.notes: This is the safest next Source-sidecar slice because it validates runtime context without expanding UI.

slices.name: Nexus context adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Nexus receives a scored Context Bundle before Claude invocation.
Retrieve and assemble phases preserve existing six-phase runPipeline semantics.
Composition can see bundle state and quality scores.
Existing Nexus tests pass or are updated with deterministic fixtures.
slices.notes: Do not rewrite prompts broadly in this slice. This is an adapter/wiring slice.

slices.name: Honest disclosure response contract
acceptanceCriteria: Disclosure language is derived from bundle state and context quality scores.
Confidence qualifiers are HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW based on measured quality, not static props.
Context-used indicators can list sources, files, or explicit absence of evidence.
Thin context produces honest non-fabrication behavior.
slices.notes: This slice makes the existing response primitives operational rather than decorative.

slices.name: Agent UI score wiring
acceptanceCriteria: Agent UI consistently shows confidence, context-used, sparse-context, and handoff state.
Score rendering does not make unsupported confidence claims.
No generic chatbot-only experience is introduced.
No Source UI expansion occurs.
slices.notes: Only wire surfaces already using agent response primitives. Do not invent new product flows here.

slices.name: Tenant isolation probe tests
acceptanceCriteria: Marcus T and Dr. L cross-tenant read/write probes are encoded as regression tests or deterministic scripts.
Tests assert forbidden tenant/program/deliverable/API access returns 403 or blocked JSON, never content.
No auth code is changed in this test-only slice unless founder explicitly approves a fix slice.
Probe results are documented in the final report.
slices.notes: This slice should prove the existing Cycle 2 tenant hardening, not rewrite auth.

slices.name: Programs page readiness contract
acceptanceCriteria: Programs index/detail readiness contract defines purpose, data dependencies, agent behavior, states, acceptance, and validation.
Contract explicitly forbids legacy/mock-heavy dependencies unless approved.
Contract separates code complete from verified.
No product code is modified.
slices.notes: This is a documentation-only gate before Programs canonical implementation.

slices.name: Programs canonical index/detail proof
acceptanceCriteria: Founder can open canonical Programs index/detail and answer status, value, risk, gate, and next action within 3 seconds.
Nexus recommendation is grounded in available context and does not fabricate missing deliverable content.
Tenant guard remains enforced.
Legacy /programs and preview/demo routes are not extended.
slices.notes: This slice remains blocked until the Programs readiness contract and Nexus context adapter are approved.

slices.name: Programs Nexus rail metadata binding
acceptanceCriteria: Programs Nexus rail produces RenderedResponse objects with honest_disclosure metadata for every turn.
Confidence, context-used, and missing-input affordances render via S6 wiring without changes to AgentResponse.
No model or API call is invoked; prose is composed deterministically.
Honest fallbacks surface where Business Context and Evidence are unseeded; no fabricated data.
Existing rail public props and visual geometry are preserved.
slices.notes: First Programs consumer of S5/S6 honest-disclosure metadata. Defers gate state machine to S9c, evidence and value seeding to S9d, Tower signal emission to S9e, and live agent binding to a separate slice family.

slices.name: Program phase + hard-gate status rendering
acceptanceCriteria: Six canonical phases render in order with explicit 6-state status enum (not_started/current/complete/informational/blocked/not_seeded).
Origination always renders honestly as informational/pre-seed.
Four hard gates render in order with explicit 5-state enum (informational/ready/missing_inputs/blocked/not_wired).
Gate strip never claims true approval state from the seed alone; ready is not emitted while production state machine is deferred.
Steward readiness note composes deterministically from seed (no model call), with ready / missing / blocking / deferred buckets.
Existing Programs detail public props and visual geometry are preserved.
slices.notes: Seed-only. No production state machine, no audit log writes, no model calls. Defers true gate approval to a later state-machine slice and gate-readiness signal upgrade to S9d once value and evidence are seeded.

slices.name: Program deliverables, evidence + value readiness summary
acceptanceCriteria: Deliverable tier and per-requirement counts reconcile to the seed.
Required-but-stub gaps render deterministically with resolvable route paths.
Evidence and value signals are honestly labeled not_seeded with named expected signals.
Value readiness names canonical G3 and G4 hard gates verbatim.
No ready signal is emitted while seed lacks evidence or value capture.
No live agent or model call. Detail component public props unchanged.
slices.notes: Seed-only. Evidence and value readiness exposed as explicit not_seeded signals. Promotion to ready/partial requires a future seed-population slice to populate evidence references and value ledger entries.

slices.name: Programs Control Tower signal read model
acceptanceCriteria: Every canonical demo tenant produces a deterministic signal list.
Signals are sorted by severity desc, then by canonical type rank, then by id.
High/critical signals are emitted when gate, evidence, or value readiness is missing.
routeHref always points back to the canonical tenant program route.
No signal claims evidence/value readiness while seed lacks them.
No signal invents a dollar amount.
Per-tenant aggregate equals concatenation of per-program signals (sorted).
slices.notes: Read model only. No Tower UI build, no Atlas runtime subscription, no persistence. Programs in canonical Execute phase honestly emit zero gate_missing_inputs signals because no canonical hard gate exits Execute.

slices.name: Tower Programs pressure cards
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant Tower landing renders the new Programs pressure section above the existing tower content.
Tower view helper imports only the S9e read model and never re-derives signals from canonical view modules.
Every card routeHref resolves to the canonical tenant program detail route.
No card claims evidence or value as ready while seed lacks them.
No card emits a dollar amount in any string field.
Existing assertTenantAccess and notFound behavior is preserved.
No Atlas runtime, Nexus runtime, agent runtime, Source UI, mock.ts, auth, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: First Tower UI consumer of the S9e read model. Atlas signal subscriber, persistence, aging, and notification delivery are deferred to follow-on slices.

slices.name: Tower Atlas Executive Brief for Program Pressure
acceptanceCriteria: Atlas Executive Brief panel renders above the existing program pressure cards on the canonical tenant Tower landing.
Brief is composed only from the S9e signal list and S9f Tower view; no live Atlas / Nexus / agent runtime is invoked.
Brief is byte-equal across repeated calls for the same tenant and signal list.
Confidence label is capped at medium for any seed-only signal mix; no brief claims high confidence.
No brief invents a dollar amount in any string field.
evidenceValueWarning is empty when no evidence_not_ready / value_not_ready signals exist; non-empty otherwise.
Suggested follow-ups are exactly three deterministic items, all rendered as disabled affordances; live Ask-Atlas runtime is deferred.
Empty-tenant brief returns confidenceLabel no_signals and sourceLabel deterministic_seed without fabricating an executive headline.
No Atlas runtime, Nexus runtime, agent runtime, Source UI, mock.ts, auth, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: Deterministic, seed-only Atlas brief. No model calls, no streaming compose, no Atlas turn persistence. Live Atlas subscriber, follow-up wiring, and confidence promotion to high are deferred to follow-on slices.

slices.name: Sentinel Pattern Detection Read Model
acceptanceCriteria: Every canonical demo tenant produces a deterministic Sentinel pattern detection list.
value_ledger_incompleteness triggers from value_not_ready signals only.
evidence_chain_gap triggers from evidence_not_ready signals only.
gate_governance_gap triggers from gate_missing_inputs or executive_decision_needed signals.
program_context_sparsity triggers from context_insufficient or deliverable_coverage_gap signals.
ai_governance_operating_model_gap is suppressed unless at least two distinct programs share governance/gate/evidence/value gaps.
Detection IDs follow the canonical sentinel:<tenantKey>:<patternKey> form and are unique within a tenant.
Summary counts reconcile to the detection list across pattern, confidence, and severity dimensions.
Each affected program's routeHref resolves to the canonical /tenant/<routeSlug>/programs/<programSlug> detail.
No detection invents a dollar amount in any string field.
No detection emits a timestamp, ISO date, or epoch ms; cross-call JSON output is byte-equal.
No Intelligence UI, Sentinel runtime, Atlas runtime, Nexus runtime, agent runtime, Source UI, mock.ts, auth, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: Read model only. No Intelligence UI build (deferred to I2), no live Sentinel runtime, no Atlas editorial handoff, no persistence. Confidence cap at medium for single-program detections is enforced because the seed cannot defend a higher claim alone.

slices.name: Intelligence · Sentinel Brief + Active Patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant Intelligence landing route renders the Sentinel brief + active patterns section using the I1 read model.
View helper imports only the I1 detection module and the seed planner; never re-derives detections.

Sentinel brief includes title, topPattern, topSeverity, topConfidence, whatSentinelSees, whyItMatters, affectedPrograms, recommendedAction, suggestedHandoffs, suggestedFollowUps, sourceLabel, interpretationBasis.
suggestedFollowUps has exactly three deterministic items in canonical order, all enabled: false.
Pattern cards correspond 1:1 to I1 detections in the same sort order.
Affected program routeHref resolves to the canonical /tenant/<routeSlug>/programs/<programSlug> detail.
Detection routeHref points to the future /tenant/<routeSlug>/intelligence/patterns/<patternKey> route.
No brief or card invents a dollar amount in any string field.
No claim of live Sentinel runtime today; chips are visible-but-disabled.
Empty-tenant view returns sourceLabel deterministic_seed and topSeverity / topConfidence NONE without fabricating a headline.
Existing assertTenantAccess and notFound behavior is preserved on the route.
No Sentinel runtime, Atlas runtime, Nexus runtime, agent runtime, Source UI, mock.ts, auth implementation, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: First Intelligence-page consumer of the I1 read model. Pattern detail drawer, evidence trail, graph traversal, live Sentinel validation, and Atlas editorial handoff are deferred to I3 and beyond.

slices.name: Intelligence · Pattern Detail / Evidence Trail
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant Sentinel pattern detail route renders via /tenant/<routeSlug>/intelligence/patterns/<patternKey> for canonical I1 pattern keys.
buildSentinelPatternDetailView returns null when the pattern key is unknown or when the tenant has no detection for that key.
isSentinelPatternKey type guard accepts only the 5 canonical SentinelPatternKey values.

Pattern detail view exposes patternKey, patternName, confidence, severity, title, summary, whyItMatters, affected programs, source signal IDs, evidence trail rows, missing inputs, recommended action, handoff rows, intelligenceLandingHref, sourceLabel, interpretationBasis.
Affected program rows route back to the canonical /tenant/<routeSlug>/programs/<programSlug>.
Evidence trail rows trace back 1:1 to detection.sourceSignalIds and detection.evidenceSignals from I1.
Citation readiness reports not_yet_wired today; no row claims a real citation.
No invented dollar amount in any string field on the detail view.
No claim of live Sentinel runtime; sourceLabel is deterministic_seed or pattern_detection_read_model.
Route preserves legacy /tenant/<routeSlug>/intelligence/patterns/<seed-slug> behavior by falling back to <SeedTenantPattern> when the slug is not a canonical Sentinel pattern key.
Existing assertTenantAccess and notFound behavior is preserved on the route.
No Sentinel runtime, Atlas runtime, Nexus runtime, agent runtime, Source UI, mock.ts, auth implementation, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: Pattern detail surface for Sentinel keys; legacy [patternSlug] route was deleted to resolve a Next.js dynamic-segment-name collision and the new [patternKey] route falls back to SeedTenantPattern for any non-Sentinel slug. Evidence registry citation, graph traversal, authored pattern renderer, and live Sentinel validation are deferred to I4+.

slices.name: Steward Setup/Admin · Apple-like Control Plane Contract
acceptanceCriteria: Contract names Setup/Admin as the Steward-led control plane, not a settings page.
Contract enumerates the seven primary users.
Contract enumerates the nine admin questions the surface must answer.
Contract defines the seven Steward responsibilities in Admin.
Contract states the Apple-like experience principles.
Contract defines the five canonical Admin zones (header, brief, cards, explorer, drawer).
Contract defines the ten canonical Admin modules.
Contract defines twelve canonical Enterprise Dataset Domains, each with example datasets, why-it-matters, agents, surfaces, readiness criteria, common missing inputs, and Steward guidance.
Contract defines the Data Explorer field set and drawer behavior.
Contract defines the nine canonical evidence states (loaded → usable_as_evidence + blocked) and per-agent effect.
Contract defines the Users & Access, Security & Governance, and Connector contracts.
Contract defines the seven AI Control Tower dimensions and per-dimension agent role.
Contract defines the Agent Readiness Matrix shape for Nexus, Sentinel, Atlas, Steward.
Contract defines the deterministic Steward Brief field set and example.
Contract enumerates UI states, actions, acceptance criteria, future implementation slices (ADM2-ADM10), and explicit defer list.
No application code, Source files, Admin UI, runtime, auth, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: Specification / contract document only. Establishes the canonical Setup/Admin control plane shape. ADM2-ADM10 implement the surface; this slice does not modify application code. No runtime, no migrations, no model calls.

slices.name: Steward Setup Home / Control Center
acceptanceCriteria: Read model exposes the 12 canonical Enterprise Dataset Domains from ADM1 in canonical ordinal order with status, counts, example datasets, missing inputs, agents, surfaces, Steward guidance per row.
Evidence aggregate exposes byState entries for all 9 canonical evidence states with monotonic non-increasing counts across the progression.
totalLoaded / totalAvailable / totalUsable reconcile to byState.loaded / byState.indexed / byState.usable_as_evidence.
Agent Readiness Matrix has all four canonical agents (Nexus, Sentinel, Atlas, Steward) with status, canUse, missingContext, safeToAnswer, mustDefer, nextAdminAction per row.

Steward Brief carries title, tenantSetupHealth (label + rationale), topAdminGaps, dataEvidenceReadiness, userSecurityRisk, connectorRisk, agentReadiness sentences, recommendedNextAction, three deterministic disabled suggestedFollowUps, sourceLabel, interpretationBasis.
Steward Brief recommendedNextAction equals recommendedActions[0].
Admin modules include all ten canonical ADM1 modules including Build Progress / Founder Control Tower; every module has a routeHref starting with /.
Brief never invents a dollar amount in any string field.
Brief never claims a live runtime; connector posture honestly reads not_started or 0 of 0.
Component imports only next/link and the ADM2 read model; no imports from Source UI, Nexus / Sentinel / Atlas / Agent runtime, legacy /programs, mock.ts, or auth.
Existing /platform/admin guard, sidebar items, and Build Progress route are preserved unchanged.
No Sentinel runtime, Atlas runtime, Nexus runtime, agent runtime, Source UI, mock.ts, auth implementation, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: First Apple-like Admin / Setup landing surface implementing ADM1 §F (zones), §G (modules), §H (12 dataset domains), §J (evidence states), §O (agent readiness), §P (Steward Brief). No live Steward runtime, no upload pipeline, no connector sync, no permission editor, no migrations. ADM3+ slices drill into the per-object detail.

slices.name: Dataset Domain Inventory Read Model
acceptanceCriteria: summary.byDomain covers all 12 canonical Enterprise Dataset Domains.
buildDatasetDomainInventoryForDomain returns non-empty items for active domains and empty list for not_started domains and unknown keys.
Every item carries the full ADM1 §I field set with deterministic seed-only data.
Item ids are unique; every id matches the ds:<domainKey>:<slug> pattern.
summary.loadedTotal / availableTotal / usableTotal reconcile to the canonical evidence progression (loaded >= available >= usable).
byUsability covers all 9 canonical evidence states; byParseStatus covers all 4 parse states.
No item claims sourceType connector or non-null connector today; no item asserts a real E-### citation.
agentsAllowedToUse contains only Nexus / Sentinel / Atlas / Steward.
Blocked items only allow Steward in agentsAllowedToUse.
No invented dollar amount in any string field.
Module imports nothing from Source UI, Nexus / Sentinel / Atlas / Agent runtime, legacy /programs, mock.ts, auth, or supabase.
slices.notes: Pure deterministic dataset inventory consumed by ADM4 (Dataset Explorer UI) and downstream ADM5 / 7 / 9 surfaces. No live connector sync, no upload pipeline, no production evidence registry, no DB persistence. Future connector / upload / registry slices flip per-item state without contract changes.

slices.name: Intelligence · Pattern Content Renderer / Detail Enrichment
acceptanceCriteria: buildSentinelPatternAuthoredContent returns deterministic content for each of the 5 canonical I1 pattern keys.
buildSentinelPatternAuthoredContent returns null for unknown keys.
Each canonical pattern carries definition, howSentinelDetected, whyItMatters, failureModes (>=1), interventions (>=1), requiredEvidence (>=1), handoffGuidance (>=1), contentCompleteness, authoredAt.
howSentinelDetected only references the canonical S9e signal types.
relatedPatterns reference only canonical I1 pattern keys with no self-reference.
Content does not invent a dollar amount in any string field.
Content does not claim live retrieval / live model invocation.
SentinelPatternContentPanel renders source · deterministic seed chip and disclaims live retrieval in footer.
SentinelPatternDetail integrates SentinelPatternContentPanel via PatternAuthoredContentSection.
Module imports nothing from Sentinel runtime, Atlas / Nexus / agent runtime, Source UI, legacy /programs, mock.ts, auth, supabase, or model SDKs.
slices.notes: Authored deterministic content for each of the 5 canonical I1 pattern keys. No live Sentinel runtime, no graph traversal, no Claude / OpenAI / Pinecone invocation. Future content management, graph traversal, and registry-bound evidence can swap content entries without contract changes.

slices.name: Agentic Spine Verification Runbook
acceptanceCriteria: Runbook documents branch hygiene checklist with exact git commands and pass criteria.
Runbook lists required validation commands (tsc, jest suites, build) with pass criteria.
Runbook enumerates the seven canonical routes to live-walk: Programs index, Programs detail, Tower, Intelligence, Pattern detail, Admin, Build Progress.

Runbook defines per-route checklists for Programs (Nexus rail, six phases, four gates), Tower (pressure cards, Atlas Executive Brief), Intelligence (Sentinel Brief, Active Patterns, evidence trail, disabled chips), and Admin (Build Progress, Setup / Steward Control Center, data + agent readiness).
Runbook defines tenant isolation checks including the S7 probe and cross-tenant URL / API probes.
Runbook defines no-fabrication checks: no fake dollars, no fake citations, no live model claim, deterministic-source captions visible.
Runbook defines the morning review decision matrix (keep / amend / discard / cherry-pick / push / PR) with a default to not-push for unsupervised batches.
Documentation only; no application code, runtime, auth, supabase, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: Founder-facing checklist for verifying the agentic spine before push, PR, or demo. Deterministic — does not exercise live retrieval or model calls. Default policy for unsupervised batch runs: local commits only; morning review owns push / PR decisions.

slices.name: AI Control Tower Product Contract
acceptanceCriteria: Contract defines purpose, three executive questions, and scope.
Contract enumerates the seven primary users.
Contract names Atlas as primary agent with Nexus / Sentinel / Steward feeders.
Contract defines the seven canonical dimensions with required datasets, KPIs, and per-agent role per dimension.
Contract defines the Atlas Tower brief field set, voice, and length limit.
Contract enforces five-scorecard / three-pressure-card / one-active-lens limits.
Contract specifies Ask Atlas drawer (not chat) with disabled follow-up chips until live runtime lands.
Contract distinguishes internal vs. external data basis.
Contract enumerates eight no-fabrication rules.
Contract proposes the future-slice plan ACT2 through ACT10.
Documentation only; no application code, runtime, auth, supabase, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: Specification only. Establishes the canonical AI Control Tower product shape: 7 dimensions, 5 scorecards, 3 pressure cards, 1 active lens, Atlas brief, drawer-not-chat, internal-vs-external basis, no-fabrication rules. ACT2-ACT10 implement the surface.

slices.name: Maestro Workshop Intelligence Contract
acceptanceCriteria: Contract names the Client Maestro as the human leading the engagement; the platform never replaces the Maestro.
Contract names Nexus as program mastermind and AbarVa SMEs as recommendations not auto-assignments.
Contract defines the before-workshop brief field set: objective, requiredAttendees, preReadList, agenda, questionsToAsk, likelyTensions, decisionPoints, evidenceChecklist.
Contract defines the during/after capture types: notes, decisions, risks, objections, missingInputs, stakeholderAlignment, followUpActions.
Contract defines the after-workshop synthesis: program state update, deliverable revision, gate readiness update, next session recommendation, executive summary.
Contract defines save / stop / start program state lifecycle with audit-row emission.
Contract defines meeting notes ingestion excluding audio + real-time transcription in v1.
Contract defines SME recommendation logic surfacing top three with the Maestro deciding.
Contract defines deterministic deliverable refinement loop (Stub -> Outline -> Rich) without live model invocation in v1.
Contract defines per-agent roles: Nexus, Sentinel, Steward, Atlas; Atlas never speaks during the workshop itself.
Contract proposes future slices MW2 through MW7.
Documentation only; no application code, runtime, auth, supabase, or migrations are modified.
slices.notes: Specification only. Establishes the canonical Maestro Workshop Intelligence shape: Maestro / Nexus / SME role partition, before/during/after capture, save/stop/start lifecycle, deterministic synthesis, SME recommendation, deliverable refinement loop. MW2-MW7 implement the surface.

slices.name: AI Program Failure Modes Pattern Pack
acceptanceCriteria: Pack contains exactly the 12 canonical AI program failure modes in canonical order.

Each mode carries key, name, definition, whyItMatters, commonSignals, requiredEvidence, phaseWhereDetected, recommendedIntervention, gateImplication, deliverableImplication, primaryAgent, handoffAgents, createdFrom.
Every mode names a primary agent from {nexus, sentinel, atlas, steward} and at least one handoff agent.
getAiProgramFailureMode returns null for unknown keys.
mapSignalsToFailureModes filters non-canonical signal types and returns canonical-order results regardless of input order.
summarizeFailureModes reconciles byPrimaryAgent to totalCount and exposes byGate / byPhase covering canonical enums.
No mode invents a dollar amount in any string field.
Module imports nothing from Sentinel / Atlas / Nexus / Agent runtime, Source UI, legacy /programs, mock.ts, auth, or supabase.
slices.notes: Deterministic pattern pack of AI program failure modes. No live runtime, no model calls. Future slices PF2 / PF3 / PF4 wire the pack into Sentinel detections, Programs / Atlas surfacing, and per-tenant persistence.

slices.name: Program Deliverables / Artifacts Read Model
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory builds deterministically for every (tenant, program) pair across all four canonical demo tenants.

Every artifact carries id, programCode, programSlug, tenantKey, tenantRouteSlug, routeHref, type, fileChip, title, description, phaseBucket, phaseSpec, status, renderMode, renderableInCanvas, downloadable, evidenceUsability, honestFallback, createdFrom.
Artifact ids are unique within a single inventory.
Artifacts are sorted by phase bucket then type then id.
groupArtifactsByPhase / summarizeProgramArtifacts / getRenderableDeliverables compose pure from the artifact list.
byType, byPhase, byStatus counts reconcile to the artifact list.
downloadable is always false today; download / export pipeline is deferred.
No artifact invents a dollar amount or claims a real E-### citation.
Every artifact carries a non-empty honestFallback caption.
Module imports nothing from Source UI, Sentinel / Atlas / Nexus / Agent runtime, legacy /programs, mock.ts, auth, or supabase.
slices.notes: Pure deterministic projection of (tenant, program) seed into a per-program artifact inventory. No upload, no parse, no export, no canvas rendering. Future deliverable canvas / upload pipeline / export slices flip per-artifact state without contract changes.

slices.name: Dataset Explorer UI
acceptanceCriteria: Dataset explorer view exposes all 12 canonical dataset domains in canonical ordinal order.
View totalLoadedAcrossDomains / totalUsableAcrossDomains reconcile to summary loadedTotal / usableTotal.
Per-domain rollup respects loadedCount >= availableCount >= usableCount.
Domains with zero loaded items report status not_started.
Panel imports only next/link, the ADM4 view helper, and ADM3 inventory types.
No item claims a live connector sync; no item references a production URL; no item asserts a real E-### citation.
interpretationBasis explicitly names the deterministic source-of-truth limit.
StewardSetupControlCenter imports and mounts the DatasetExplorerPanel.
Object inspector slot renders an honest empty placeholder.
Module imports nothing from Sentinel / Atlas / Nexus / Agent runtime, Source UI, legacy /programs, mock.ts, auth, or supabase.
slices.notes: Apple-like dataset explorer that consumes the ADM3 inventory deterministically. Read-only. Connector sync, upload pipeline, evidence registry, and object inspector drawer are deferred.

slices.name: AbarVa Visual Canon
acceptanceCriteria: Canon document declares brand direction, wordmark rule, symbol rule, color palette, typography, light/dark surface usage, top-nav contract, agent visual treatment, icon restraint, card/table/drawer style, progressive-disclosure rules, and no-clutter rules.
Color palette names NAVY (#1B2B5C) as the single brand accent and reserves dark surfaces for high-impact briefs only.
Typography direction is DM Sans body + JetBrains Mono mono; serif body is explicitly retired from v2.
Wordmark rule is typographic (no SVG) with the Abar/Va split, NAVY Va half 1.05-1.10x larger than Abar half.
Agent visual treatment maps Nexus / Sentinel / Atlas / Steward to canonical accents.
Component recipes describe surface and props for the eleven canonical primitives implemented by DES2.
Each page blueprint (Programs / Intelligence / AI Control Tower / Admin Setup) lists hide/show rules and acceptance criteria.
No app code is touched; this is documentation only.
slices.notes: Documentation-only foundation slice. Captures the AbarVa visual direction so DES2 primitives and DES3+ page refresh slices have a single source of truth. No runtime, no model calls, no migrations.

slices.name: Core UI Primitives
acceptanceCriteria: abarva-theme.ts exports COLORS, FONT, TYPE, SPACING, RADIUS, BORDER, AGENT_ACCENT, ABARVA_AGENT_NAMES (4), ABARVA_STATUS_KEYS (7), ABARVA_FILE_CHIPS (7), ABARVA_EVIDENCE_STATES (6), and a total statusAccent() helper.
COLORS.navy is exactly #1B2B5C and FONT.body is DM Sans (no Georgia, no Times).
All eleven primitives live under src/components/abarva/ and are server components (no useState, no useEffect, no fetch).
Top nav exposes the canonical surface tuple ABARVA_TOP_NAV_SURFACES in canonical order.
Agent partition maps the four canonical agents (Nexus / Sentinel / Atlas / Steward) to the canon accents.
Status partition maps the seven canonical status keys (ready / low / medium / partial / high / blocked / critical) to NAVY / AMBER / RED accent tiers.
Module hygiene tests block accidental imports from Sentinel / Atlas / Nexus / Agent runtime, Source UI, mock.ts, auth, or supabase, and ban Date.now / Math.random / anthropic / openai usage.
slices.notes: Eleven calm, deterministic React primitives plus a single shared theme module that encodes the DES1 canon. No client interactivity, no model calls. DES3+ page refresh slices migrate Programs / Intelligence / AI Control Tower / Admin Setup onto these primitives.
